concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (cross‑validated R² measured against a null‑baseline predictor) has no supporting task. No task generates or records a null‑model baseline for comparison, making SC‑001 untestable.

Functional Requirement FR-010 (CPU‑only execution, no GPU/CUDA) is not explicitly covered by any task. While T014 checks runtime limits, no task enforces or verifies that the XGBoost installation is pinned to a CPU‑only build, leaving the CPU‑only constraint unguaranteed.

The solder_dataset.schema.yaml contract is defined, but there is no task that validates the curated CSV (or any derived files) against this schema. Without explicit schema‑validation task, compliance with the contract cannot be assured.
